preconditions.expression: all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str1)
preconditions.description: str1 must only contain the characters '*', '#', or '@'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str2)
preconditions.description: str2 must only contain the characters '*', '#', or '@'.
The length of str1 must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The length of str2 must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer.
The return value must be between 0 and the minimum length of str1 and str2 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(str1[i] == str2[j] for i, j in zip(range(return_value), range(return_value)) if str1[i] in str2 and str2[j] in str1)
postconditions.description: The return value represents the maximum number of non-intersecting bridges that can be built between matching trees in str1 and str2.
